name: Indigenous Worlds: Histories, Knowledges, and Futures
description: Becoming human – evolution, migration, and early societies; agriculture, settlement, socio-ecological transformations; first contact and conquest; colonial capitalism, extractivism, and othering of the indigenous peoples; indigenous knowledge, ecology, and cosmologies; conservation, development, tourism, and indigenous peoples; eco-development, carbon markets, and indigenous peoples; indigenous resistance and resurgence; indigenous futures, pluriverses, and global possibilities.
